chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Aban, from Abu Maryam, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
He was asked about mut'ah, and he said: "Mut'ah today is not as it was before today. At that time, they used to be trusted, but today they are not trusted, so ask about them."

key_terms.الْيَوْمَ: the present time, indicating changed circumstances
key_terms.عَنْهُنَّ: about them, referring to the women in question
key_terms.يُؤْمَنَّ: to be trusted or considered reliable

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about mut'ah in later times?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses mut'ah and indicates that social conditions had changed from earlier times. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام instructs that one should inquire about women beforehand, highlighting caution and verification in such marriages.
